name: Platinic-Bajada
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by towering mountain ranges near the terminator.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
There is money in iron here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
